1.title: Response time per service as timeseries
1.query:
fetch spans, scanLimitGBytes: 500
| filter lower(gen_ai.system) == "amazon"
| fieldsAdd span.status_code = if(span.status_code != "", span.status_code, else: "success") 
| makeTimeseries { avg=avg(duration, default:0) }, by: { service.name, span.status_code }, time: start_time

5.title: Response time per Model
5.query:
fetch spans, scanLimitGBytes: 500
| filter lower(gen_ai.system) == "amazon" and gen_ai.response.model != ""
| fieldsKeep gen_ai.response.model, duration, end_time
| makeTimeseries avg(duration), nonempty: true, by: { gen_ai.response.model }, time: end_time

6.title: Total Token Consumption
6.query:
fetch spans
| filter lower(gen_ai.system) == "amazon"
| fieldsAdd 
    newInput = coalesce(asLong(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens), 0), 
    oldInput = coalesce(asLong(gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens), 0),
    newOutput = coalesce(asLong(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens), 0), 
    oldOutput = coalesce(asLong(gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens), 0)
| fieldsAdd tokens = (newInput + oldInput + newOutput + oldOutput) 
| makeTimeseries inputToken=sum(tokens)
| fieldsAdd avg=arraySum(inputToken)

7.title: Completion Token
7.query:
fetch spans
| filter lower(gen_ai.system) == "amazon"
| fieldsAdd 
    newOutput = coalesce(asLong(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens), 0), 
    oldOutput = coalesce(asLong(gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens), 0)
| fieldsAdd tokens = (newOutput + oldOutput) 
| makeTimeseries outputToken=sum(tokens)
| fieldsAdd avg=arraySum(outputToken)

8.title: Prompt Token
8.query:
fetch spans
| filter lower(gen_ai.system) == "amazon"
| fieldsAdd 
    newInput = coalesce(asLong(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens), 0), 
    oldInput = coalesce(asLong(gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens), 0)
| fieldsAdd tokens = (newInput + oldInput) 
| makeTimeseries inputToken=sum(tokens)
| fieldsAdd avg=arraySum(inputToken)

10.title: Forecast Cost Analysis in $
10.query:
fetch spans
| filter lower(gen_ai.system) == "amazon"
| fieldsKeep start_time, gen_ai.usage.output_tokens, gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens, gen_ai.usage.input_tokens, gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens
| fieldsAdd inputToken = coalesce(asLong(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens), 0)
| fieldsAdd oldFormatInput = coalesce(asLong(gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens), 0)
| fieldsAdd outputToken = coalesce(asLong(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens), 0)
| fieldsAdd oldFormatOutput = coalesce(asLong(gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens), 0)
| fieldsAdd input = inputToken + oldFormatInput
| fieldsAdd output = outputToken + oldFormatOutput
| fieldsAdd cost = (input  * 1) + (output  * 1)
| makeTimeseries costs = avg(cost), interval: 10m

34.title: Top 3 expensive prompts
34.query:
fetch spans
| filter lower(gen_ai.system) == "amazon"
| fieldsAdd inputToken = coalesce(asLong(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens), 0)
| fieldsAdd oldFormatInput = coalesce(asLong(gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens), 0)
| fieldsAdd outputToken = coalesce(asLong(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens), 0)
| fieldsAdd oldFormatOutput = coalesce(asLong(gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens), 0)
| fieldsAdd input = inputToken + oldFormatInput
| fieldsAdd output = outputToken + oldFormatOutput
| fieldsAdd cost = (input  * 1) + (output  * 1)
| fieldsAdd prompt = gen_ai.prompt.0.user
| fieldsAdd response = gen_ai.completion.0.content
| filter response != ""
| summarize {
token=sum(cost),
trace=takeAny(record(trace.id, end_time, start_time))
}, by: {prompt, response}
| sort token desc
| fields trace.id=trace[trace.id], token, prompt, response
| limit 3

//| filter trace.id == toUid("0a5018b5a675162083d754823257b946")

| fieldsAdd bedrock.travel_adviser_v1 = tmp
| fields prompt, bedrock.travel_adviser_v1, bedrock.travel_adviser_v2
